regressions_fixed.problem: Nikon ordinary-row and HE decode published a selected profile but bypassed the shared optical sink.
regressions_fixed.evidence: The Nikon Z f sample was bitwise identical to baseline despite LENSFUN_DISTORTION_APPLIED. The required changed-pixel assertion failed; it was not relaxed.
regressions_fixed.fix: Route the common row spool through CameraRgbSink; release the integer sensor spool before geometry.

regressions_fixed.problem: A loose whole-output interval enclosure could crop more of the previously supported RF16 view.
regressions_fixed.fix: Subdivide the continuous rectangle before increasing zoom, preserving the source-window and Jacobian checks.

regressions_fixed.problem: An absolute-term focus bound discarded signed PA polynomial cancellation and rejected the real RF135 interval.
regressions_fixed.fix: Use full-radius extrema of the interval-center polynomial plus remainder; retain the 2% threshold and native coefficients.

regressions_fixed.problem: The vendored DNG metadata-only dummy call decoded full pixel data before resource admission.
regressions_fixed.fix: Return empty dummy pixel storage while retaining metadata; valid and malformed actual decoding remain independently tested.

reproduction: From codecs, load the normal Rust/libjxl build environment.
codec_probe encode OUTPUT.rgb OUTPUT.jpg JPEG WIDTH HEIGHT sRGB
Compile tests/jni/FullLensfunSmoke.java with NativeCodecBridge.java, then run with -Dfilmroom.expectedSoSha256=SHA and final SO/private-root/GRIII/NEF/RF135 arguments.
Fetch public originals using source_evidence URLs, verify input SHA-256, and compare complete little-endian float32 RGB payloads; controlled changes and hashes are recorded per input.
limits: Complete database inclusion and numeric reference checks do not establish real-image quality for every record or missing camera/lens capture combination.
These final production samples cover ARW, RAF, ORF, CR3, NEF and original CFA DNG. CR2/PEF/RW2 full-library real-image execution is not added by this gate.
Vignetting requires actual aperture and bounded focus evidence; missing parameters skip only that operation. ORF external shading stays disabled until uncorrected source shading is established.
Native embedded operations remain authoritative per operation; converted DNG and opcode-tag controls retain baseline pixels.
Host RSS includes runtime and resident file-backed mappings and is distinct from admission accounting. It is not Android device memory.
No Android NDK/ABI build, device run or APK size delta was measured here. SO and Deflate deltas are Linux x86-64 host results only.
Public sample metadata and hashes are committed, not the full RAW files or full-resolution RGB spools. Only the four new CC0 JPEG comparisons are redistributed.
